title: [FMLA 04] NormalP — Normal Probability P(x)
summary: Standard normal CDF up to x (Hastings approximation). Prompt is x; range 0 ≤ x < 10⁵⁰.

body.text: Calculator scroll name: NormalP. Standard normal CDF up to x (Hastings approximation). The calculator prompt is x, not t.
Picture a hill centred at 0. P(x) answers: “starting from the far left, how much of the hill have I covered when I stop at x?” A larger x covers more of the hill, so P(x) is closer to 1.

body.caption: Standard bell (mean 0, spread 1). P(x) is the shaded area from the far left up to x. Here x = 1, so P(1) ≈ 0.8413 — about 84% of the hill sits to the left of 1.

body.title: How to run
items: Press FMLA, then 0, then 4 (or scroll to the name and EXE)

body.label: Limits
body.text: Hastings-style approximation. Official range is 0 ≤ x < 1×10⁵⁰ — a negative x is out of range, not Φ(−1). For P(Z ≤ −a) use 1 − P(a), or 0.5 − Q(a) with FMLA 05.
